caseNameFull: Baird v. Franklin, Treasurer and New York Yacht Club v. Franklin, Treasurer
attorneys: Messrs. Gran-ville Whittlesey, Jr., Ralstone R. Irvine, and Theodore S. Hope, Jr. for petitioner in No. Ill; and Mr. William Greenough for petitioner in No. 112., Messrs. William Dean Embree, Lawrence Bennett, and Edward N. Perkins for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari

to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
